item.tib: dbal phur nag po'i sbyin sreg las sbyor me lce 'bar ba
item.coloph: dbal phur nag po'i sbyin sreg me lce 'bar ba zhes bya ba/ spa gro'i gcal nas gter mdzod bla ma ku pas phyes/ gter shog sgrol bur bcas pa rong po mgar la bab/ gtso dang me la brgyud nas bru ston bdag gis zhus/ 'di sgrub las dang nyon mong bsregs 'tshig shog/
